body.y:
Kohelet is the book of King Shlomo. He honestly tested what makes a person happy.

The book begins with the words “All is futile.” But at the end there is an answer. It is hidden in seven worlds.
body.t:
Kohelet is one of the books of the Tanach (the Hebrew Bible). These are the words of King Shlomo (in English, Solomon), his reflections on life: he honestly tested what makes a person happy.

The book opens with words that frighten many people: “All is futile.” And it ends with an answer. That answer is hidden in seven worlds.
